== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Luke? Luuuuke! (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_44</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 44E), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-44E-Luke_Luuuuke.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-lukeluuuuke-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Luke? Luuuuke! (V)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A (Errata), p. A-14 (PDF created 27 August 2012; [[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf]]; preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20150807023558/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf Internet Archive]). The only change from the original is the spelling “cancelled” (original “canceled”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on your non-droid character present at a battleground site; character may not be carried from here or move. Target a Jedi at a site. You lose no more than 1 Force to Force drains at target's location. This Utinni Effect cancelled when reached by target.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker), STANDARD rev 71: the card's own Virtual Legacy card (same Decipher art, frame, lore, icons, slip number and Virtual Block 1 set mark as the printed card) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
